sn56.32:2.2: “Acacia” (_khadira_) is *Senegalia catechu*, whose leaves are compounded of many tiny leaflets like a fern. | “Pine” (_sarala_) is *Pinus roxburghii*. | “Myrobalan” (_āmalaka_) is *Phyllanthus emblica*, whose leaves are very small. | Read _tālapakka_ per BJT.
sn56.32:4.2: These plants all have large, broad leaves.
